method: Manual rewrite of the complete 委 boundary around the concrete bend image, restoration of the common lexical target entrust, and cleanup of nine malformed or unnecessarily cumbersome targets.

roots.reason: Entrust is a common modern lexical use, while bend is an attested older sense and a concrete image. It explains the large curve, droop, wilt, shortness, winding, hair, tassel, and sprain family far better than the abbreviation committee.
